observations: Three same-rice packs cost 3.50 for 500 g, 5.10 for 750 g, and 8.40 for 1.2 kg.
Pouring each revealed normalized prices seventy, sixty-eight and seventy cents per hundred grams.
Lowering large-pack price to 7.20 changed its unit price to sixty cents and highlighted it as best.
Reveal recalls original cheapest medium pack and explicitly includes changed large-pack price, invented-price provenance, storage and waste caveat.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Normalize grams and kilograms before comparison.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Three pour buttons and a price slider.

whyCool: A bigger pack can have the same unit price as the smallest while the middle one wins.
caveat: Invented prices and same product; unit price alone does not account for unused goods.
effort: Prediction, all three pours, price reversal, screenshots and context-aware reveal.
bucketReason: Practical, reversible normalized comparison with explicit consumption limits.

prediction.reason: Precise unit comparison with plausible size and sticker-price biases.

interaction.reason: Three normalized packs and editable large price demonstrate reversal.
interaction.evidence: Medium cheapest initially; large cheapest at 7.20.

payoff.reason: Explains original and changed cases plus a meaningful limit.
payoff.evidence: Price divided by quantity; lower rate helps only if used.

clarity.reason: Comparable per-hundred-gram bars and labels make ranking clear.
clarity.evidence: Seventy, sixty-eight, seventy then sixty cents.

transfer.reason: Concrete shopping rule with usage condition.

surprise.reason: The largest pack ties the smallest rather than beating it.

visualExplanation.evidence: Different pack sizes become common per-unit prices.

playfulness.reason: Reveal each pack and adjust one price.
playfulness.evidence: No custom pack sizes or other goods.

practicalValue.reason: Direct reusable comparison with tested ranking change and a usage caveat.
practicalValue.evidence: Original medium winner versus changed large winner; waste/storage matter.

depth.reason: Separates sticker price, quantity, rate and use.
depth.evidence: Rate need not decrease with size.
